title: Smart Green Nudging: Reducing Product Returns Through Digital Footprints and Causal Machine Learning
authors: Moritz von Zahn; Kevin Bauer; Cristina Mihale-Wilson; Johanna Jagow; Maximilian Speicher; Oliver Fast Hinz
eligible_reason: Randomized green-nudge field experiment analyzed with a causal forest (CausalForestDML) for personalized targeting. No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: src/simulate_data.py generates T (random nudge), X1-X7, Y (return); cml_training.py fits CausalForestDML; cml_evaluation.py produces GATE and IPS plots.
data_files_note: README: 'training a causal machine learning model based on simulated data'; data created by simulate_data.py.
data_provenance_note: Simulated experiment data (40,000 train / 10,000 test rows).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
